summary: Tested v0.15: registration approval (backend + UI) and the inactivity auto-logout. Backend: pytest tests/test_v015_registration_approval.py passed 15 of 16 tests. The one failure is a minor 500 on an invalid ObjectId. Frontend: the /register pending screen, the /utenti approvals box (approve, reject with confirm/dismiss, list refresh, pending users hidden from the main table), the Audit Log labels, and the inactivity dialog and logout all work. One bug: no sonner <Toaster/> is mounted anywhere in the app, so none of the toast messages appear. This includes 'Sei stato disconnesso per inattività' and 'Registrazione approvata/rifiutata'. Guide content was checked in the source files: the 'Limiti noti' chapter no longer lists inactivity logout or registration approval, and the Iscritto guide has 'Attendi l'approvazione' and 'Uscita automatica'.

minor.issue: A non-ObjectId id (e.g. 'not-an-id') returns 500 (bson InvalidId is not caught). It should return 400 or 404. The same pattern exists in other /users/{id} endpoints and in register when sede_id is invalid.

ui_bugs.issue: The sonner <Toaster /> is never mounted (grep finds no '<Toaster' in src). Every toast.info/success/error call from 'sonner' is invisible: the inactivity logout toast 'Sei stato disconnesso per inattività', the approve/reject toasts in RegistrazioniInAttesa (including error messages such as 403), and the GuidaPage download toast. The redirect to /login does work.

action_items: Mount the sonner Toaster once at app root, e.g. in App.js: import { Toaster } from 'sonner' (or components/ui/sonner) and render <Toaster richColors position='top-right' /> inside the providers. Then re-check the inactivity toast and the approve/reject toasts.
Catch bson InvalidId in approva/rifiuta (and other ObjectId(user_id) calls) and return 400 or 404 instead of 500.
critical_code_review_comments: InattivitaLogout.esci: if axios POST /auth/logout fails, AuthContext.logout throws before setUser(false). The user state stays set and navigate('/login') may bounce back. Call setUser(false) in a finally block inside logout.
InattivitaLogout resets sla_last_activity on mount, so opening or reloading another tab counts as activity. This is acceptable but worth knowing.
_notify_users_by_role does not exclude disabled or in_attesa users. Pending users with a privileged role cannot normally exist via self-registration, so the risk is low.

Approva and rifiuta are not atomic: the find and the update/delete are separate steps, so two concurrent calls could both pass the check. Use find_one_and_update/delete with the filter {stato_approvazione:'in_attesa'}.
seed_data_creation: The test fixtures created temporary users and a second sede in Mongo; they were cleaned up in teardown. UI-test users ui_* were deleted afterwards. Remaining users: superadmin@sla.it and pending1@test.it. The audit_log entries from the tests remain.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The pytest file creates its own users and sede with a random TAG and cleans them up. Login is rate-limited to 10/min (the test retries) and register to 3/hour (restart the backend to reset). Inactivity test: after login, set localStorage sla_last_activity = Date.now()-29.5*60*1000 without mouse moves, and the dialog appears within 1s. Only retest the toast visibility after the Toaster fix.
rca of the issue: Toast missing: components call toast() from 'sonner', but no <Toaster/> renderer is mounted in the React tree. sonner only renders toasts when a <Toaster/> exists. Reproduce: approve a registration in /utenti, or trigger the inactivity logout; no toast appears and the [data-sonner-toast] count is 0. Fix: add <Toaster/> in App.js.
